title: The squat jump,
learned.
clips.lede: A person squat-jumping on a phone video became this simulated Unitree G1, controlled by a policy trained with reinforcement learning. It's the policy, not an animation of the video. Push it.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: a person squat-jumping, twice. SAM 3.1 segments them, MediaPipe lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab across thousands of simulated G1s, on 36 automatic variants of the clip, with pushes during training. What you see is that network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

title: The front kick,
learned.
clips.lede: Two front kicks on a phone video, turned into a policy that balances on one leg through each kick. Push it mid-kick.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: two front kicks with the right leg. SAM 3.1 segments the person, MediaPipe lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 automatic variants of the clip (mirrored, re-timed, rescaled), with pushes during training. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

title: The squat,
learned.
clips.lede: Two slow squats on a phone video. The policy follows the reference within a few degrees per joint, and keeps its feet planted when pushed.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: two bodyweight squats. SAM 3.1 segments the person, MediaPipe lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab tracking the retarget, trained on the clip itself (2,000 iterations), with pushes during training. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

facts.l: mean joint error to the reference

title: A 1900 discus
throw, learned.
clips.lede: Josiah McCracken, a 1900 Olympic medallist, throwing the discus for Étienne-Jules Marey's camera in 1900: a 429° spin and a release. Shown here as its silhouette. Push it mid-spin.
clips.video: A public-domain 1900 film: grainy, flickering, 25 fps. SAM 3.1 still finds the athlete in every frame; MediaPipe lifts the pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab, starting from a policy trained on five other clips, then 1,500 iterations on this clip's variants. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

title: A 1900 shot put,
almost.
clips.lede: Josiah McCracken, shot put silver medallist at the 1900 Paris Olympics, filmed by Étienne-Jules Marey. The policy holds the wind-up and the throw without falling, but it doesn't learn the 1 m sideways glide yet: compare it with the retarget ghost.
clips.video: A public-domain 1900 film by Étienne-Jules Marey. SAM 3.1 finds the athlete in every frame; MediaPipe lifts the pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab, starting from a policy trained on five other clips, then 1,500 iterations on this clip's variants. It tracks the joints closely but stays near its starting spot.

facts.l: mean joint error to the reference

clips.caveat: Work in progress: no glide yet
